response.final_text:
**Proposed disposition:** CLOSE_FP, confidence 0.9. The proposal is filed and waits for a human decision.

**What drove it:**
1. T-MM-02 is a registered market maker on SYN.A. It quoted a symmetric bid and ask of 321 (cancel_symmetry 0.99), re-quoted every 1–10 seconds, and kept the quotes at 0.13× depth and 0.2 tick from the touch.
2. There was no opposite-side execution (opposite_side_fill_qty 0). The only fills were 92 and 44 on its own resting BUY quote. The detector's "BUY execution" is the second of those fills. Without an opposite-side trade there is no benefit, so feature (b) is absent.
3. The high order-to-trade ratio (52 against a typical 15.9) comes from continuous re-quoting. There were no repetitions in the session, no price move to the trader's favour, and no one-sided layering.

**What would change my mind:** a SELL execution by this trader at a price its bid had moved, or one-sided large resting orders on other days.

I didn't look beyond the detector window (plus 5 seconds of padding). Algorithmic re-pricing is left undetermined in the report because no parent or pegged orders were recorded, and market making alone carries the closure.
